text_block_list.text:
One weekend, I'm heading to the
shopping
district with Mihono Bourbon,
when...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The Sweet Stamp Rally is about to
begin! ☆ Now
recruiting participants!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Sweet... Stamp Rally?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Hey, you two! Wanna join the
event?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You collect one stamp for each dessert
you eat
from the different stores in the
shopping district!
choice_data_list: What kind of event is it?
What kind of event is it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you collect all fifty stamps,
you get to
eat an
exclusive, completely
custom-made confection!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Completely... custom... made...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
So... you are saying it would be possible
to craft a flawless treat that uses
adrenaline-boosting fruits
and nutrients
for increasing muscle mass?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, yeah, it's completely
custom-made, after all! No problem! The
manager should be able to
whip up
something like that!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
The total caloric content of fifty
varieties
of desserts is massive.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: However, the reward is alluring... Extremely alluring. Please, give me instructions.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's too bad! Well, you do have
some races
coming up, so it's probably
best to watch what
you eat.
choice_data_list: ……Sorry, it's a shame, but let's p...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood, Trainer. However, please
allow me
to clarify one point.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To me, your orders are infallible.
Therefore,
apologies are unnecessary. In
fact...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
U-uhhh... I feel like I'm the third wheel
here.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... You two really get along well.
Heck, the pair of you might be even
sweeter than all these
desserts put
together!

We don't end up participating in the
event... but
hearing Mihono Bourbon's
kind words warms my
heart.

And so, we end up participating in the
stamp
rally...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Munch, munch... gulp. Consumption of item fifty, the Deluxe Special Sundae, is complete.

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for participating! Now, what
would you
like for your custom-made
confection?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, you wanted a "flawless" dessert,
right?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. One that includes fruits that
provide relief
from fatigue and nutrients
for increasing muscle
mass.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I require it to include the following

ingredients—apple, natto, oyster, miso,

fermented fish, and protein powder.

text_block_list.name: Store Manager
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hahaha, got it! This will put my
thirty years
as a pastry chef to the test!

Some days later, a jet-black cake that
seems to include all the ingredients
Mihono Bourbon requested arrives, and
she polishes it off with
satisfaction.
